parent_objective: design metric definitions and instrumentation route for explicit M1743 metric gaps
blocked_by: direct execution is blocked until benchmark-critical recovery and drift metrics are defined or instrumented
supersedes: direct revised-semantics execution with unsupported metric approximations

public_gates: M1745 must define metric semantics for all seven M1743 gaps
M1745 must separate metric definition from implementation and rollout
M1745 must decide whether each metric is computable from existing rows, requires evaluator time-series logging, or requires env instrumentation
M1745 must not run environment rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat unsupported metric gaps as covered
do not implement instrumentation in the design milestone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns explicit M1743 metric gaps into a concrete metric definition and instrumentation route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout, implementation, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if any M1743 metric gap has no definition route
stop if design admits execution while benchmark-critical gaps remain unresolved
stop if design changes actor inputs or reward behavior
stop if design ranks controller-family profiles
fallback_plan: route to bounded supported-only panel design if full instrumentation is too broad
route to branch synthesis if metric definitions expose scope growth
route to instrumentation implementation preflight if definitions are concrete and bounded
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1744 blocks direct execution on benchmark-critical metric gaps

training_stage.stage_objective: design outcome metric definitions and instrumentation route
admission_evidence: M1744 audits M1743 and blocks direct execution because metric gaps are benchmark-critical
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1745 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation-preflight or bounded-panel manifest
next_stage_criteria: all seven metric gaps have metric definitions and instrumentation routes

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; metric instrumentation design cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design may preserve profile controls but must not interpret metric instrumentation as self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If metric definitions are too broad, record task-quality instrumentation scope limitation rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The explicit M1743 metric gaps can be converted into bounded metric definitions and instrumentation routes before implementation or rerun.
success_criteria: all seven M1743 metric gaps have proposed definitions and data requirements
each metric is classified as existing-row computable evaluator time-series logging or environment instrumentation
next route is implementation preflight bounded-panel design branch synthesis or stop
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: one or more M1743 metric gaps are omitted
design admits execution while benchmark-critical gaps remain unresolved
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made
decision_rule: M1745 passes if every explicit M1743 metric gap has a bounded definition and data route without admitting execution prematurely.
